prompt: Low wide view from just above the concrete, right beside the front wheel of a stripped teal 1920s hot rod: no fenders, no bonnet, bare engine, one goggled driver hunched behind a cut-down screen. The car fills the left half of the frame, sharp. Half a length behind on the right, one black hot rod of the same kind, its driver low. They run on the dry floor of a sloped concrete river channel at dusk, with a heavy arched bridge just ahead throwing its shadow. Burnt orange sky above the channel walls, teal gloom in the arch. No water, no other vehicles. Thanks.
